item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 12 #SLPRSD
Issued at 08:20 AM 31 October 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(Baleno, CityOfMasbate, Aroroy, Mandaon, Milagros, Batuan, Mobo), #Sorsogon(Casiguran, Gubat) and #NorthernSamar(SanVicente) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Sorsogon(Matnog, Bulan, SantaMagdalena, Irosin, Bulusan, Barcelona, Juban, Magallanes), #Masbate(Monreal, SanJacinto, SanFernando), #NorthernSamar(Allen, Lavezares, Biri and Capul) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
